item.title: Exploring movie similarities with vector search algorithms
item.description: This is a single walkthrough of a movie similarity thread: Part 1 stores embeddings in PostgreSQL + pgvector and runs nearest-neighbor search in SQL; Part 2 uses Qdrant with MovieLens (dense text vectors for semantic search and sparse rating vectors for collaborative-style recommendations); Part 3 turns the same pgvector-backed catalog into the retrieval layer for a small RAG pipeline with LangChain and Ollama. Below are short GIFs from that work (movie-similarities-1.gif … 3.gif in this page bundle).
